name: deviceterm
description: Skills for driving Apple devices from inside a DeviceTerm tab: orientation, app verification, App Store screenshots, accessibility audits, bug reproduction, and tab titling.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Apple devices from a DeviceTerm tab
interface.longDescription: Skills for testing and driving iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, and tvOS apps from inside a DeviceTerm tab: locating controls through the accessibility tree, verifying what an app actually did, capturing App Store screenshots, auditing accessibility, reproducing bug reports, and retitling tabs from an automation tab.
interface.defaultPrompt: Walk through my app's login flow in the simulator and tell me what actually happened.
